## Predicting this season's Premier League

In the repo, we calculate each team's chances of winning the title, being in the Champions League next year or being relegated.

When doing so, we also consider the impact of each team's next game on these chances. Specifically, we create:

 - An [interactive table](https://p0bs.github.io/pp2-scan/etable.html) that shows these chances for each team in each scenario (of whether they win, draw or lose their next game)

 - A [static plot](https://p0bs.github.io/pp2-scan/chart.svg)

 - An [interactive version](https://p0bs.github.io/pp2-scan/echart.html) of the same plot, where you can hover over the points to get more information

 All this will soon form part of a dedicated website that will include far more details. Stay tuned!
